message: Could not resolve the declaration with id '{0}' when looking for template attributes. This can happen when several referenced assemblies define a type that is part of the declaration signature.
title: Could not resolve a declaration when looking for template attributes.
rationale: The message uses a contraction ('that's'), and 'multiple references contain a type' is imprecise about the cause: the declaration id fails to resolve (TemplateAttributeFactory.TryGetTemplateAttributeById) typically because the type of the signature is defined by several referenced assemblies; the title lacks an article.
codeChange: The diagnostic is reported without a location (CreateRoslynDiagnostic( null, ... )) and only names the serialized declaration id; passing the aspect or template class name would help users find the template.
